card.name: Word 'specific' in overdose-treatment sentence
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "specific" in the phrase "serious medical problems for which specific treatments are available" in overdose management text. Weaker hits on "is" after a condition being confirmed or defined, and on odd mid-text spots.

modes.label: Specific treatments
